text:
nina: FYI sandbar13b-int4 canary started showing intermittent warmstart OOMs after the traffic spike.
nina: logs point at KV slab growth during multi-turn sessions, often right after an eviction.

sam: any correlation with prefetch or max_new_tokens?
nina: canary defaults were prefetch=10, max_new_tokens=640, microbatch=8.
devon: prefetch 10 is pretty aggressive for int4. fragmentation likely.
sam: quick mitigation: lower prefetch to 2, set max_new_tokens=256 for canaries, enable slab_compact_on_evict and soft_reserve.
nina: patched model defaults and rolled to 2/3 canary hosts.
ops-bot: deploybot: rolling update 6195550000 -> sandbar13b-int4 defaults patch started.

sam: ran a 30m A/B: OOM rate v1=9.6% -> v2=0.7%. p95 latency improved 140ms -> 100ms.
devon: caveat: very long sessions (>3k tokens) got truncated more often with max_new_tokens=256.
sam: plan: route long sessions to highmem pool and keep short/medium sessions on optimized defaults.
nina: created ticket INFRA-3438 for metrics + routing rule. Will monitor kv_alloc_peak and slab_frag_pct for 24h.
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary v2 succeeded on 3/3 hosts. Monitoring window open for 24h.

nina: thanks all — keeping an eye and will post results here. :thumbsup:
